visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an indoor gym with bright studio lighting. A man with short black hair, wearing a black long-sleeved athletic shirt and bright orange-and-black running shoes, is performing a side-lying core exercise on the floor. He uses a cable machine to pull a handle towards his waist, mimicking a leaning posture. (2) The visual cuts to a professional racing track under natural daylight. A motorcycle racer in a white, purple, and red suit is leaning extremely low into a sharp turn, with their knee and elbow nearly touching the asphalt. (3) Back in the gym, the man is now standing and using a leg-drive machine. He performs explosive stepping motions with one leg, holding onto the handles of the equipment. (4) On the racing track, a racer in a yellow and blue suit performs a high wheelie on a Yamaha motorcycle while accelerating down a straightaway. (5) In the gym, the man balances on one leg on a small platform while swinging a pink kettlebell laterally, maintaining a crouched, focused posture. (6) The video transitions to high-speed track footage showing several MotoGP racers maneuvering through a sequence of turns, leaning their bikes aggressively. (7) Returning to the gym, the man is seen sprinting intensely on a treadmill, his facial expression showing high physical exertion and focus. (8) The final visual phase shows a racer in full protective gear running across a grassy area next to the track, likely after a fall or to reach their bike.

The video uses a side-by-side comparison (or sequential montage) showing gym exercises that directly translate to the extreme leaning and control required on a professional racing motorcycle.
